# SHAP example cases (validation period, generated by explain_model.py)

Production model `lgbm-2026.10.27-1`. Alert rule: expected loss (probability x amount) >= $21.82. Cases drawn at random (seed 42) within each group. Factors are SHAP contributions to the model's risk score (log-odds): they show what pushed the score up or down, not causes.
